place.title: Place {ref} (reed switch)
place.text: Bend the reed switch {ref}'s legs down and push them into column f: one into hole {hole.a}, the other into {hole.b}, so the glass tube lies flat over the rows between.
place.tip: The glass breaks easily: bend each leg a few millimetres away from the glass, holding the leg (not the tube) with pliers or your fingers. Either leg can go in either hole.

why: {ref} is a reed switch: two thin metal strips in a glass tube touch while a magnet is near, so the Pico can tell whether the magnet is there.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s other leg to ground: while a magnet closes the contact, the pin reads 0.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}: 0 while a magnet is near (the contact joins the pin to ground) and 1 without one (the Pico's internal pull-up).
